description:
Complete a 2FA challenge using a magic link token (received via email). No code submission needed — the token itself is the proof.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Set PROOF_API_KEY and restart this server, or sign in with start_login — a session opens this tool — then call this tool again.

token.description: Magic link token from the verification email

name: verify_2fa_magic_link

action_type.description: The action the session was started for: one of `TwoFAActionType` for sessions started through this API; admin-console sessions carry internal values.

already_verified.description: Present (true) when the session had already been verified, by its code or another open of the link; no grant is stored by this call and the grant fields are absent

grant_expires_at.description: When the grant this step-up stored stops being accepted

grant_single_use.description: Whether the grant is spent by the first act it allows
